application.name: Hudhud Keyboard
application.summary: Private keyboard for English, Arabic and more, with glide typing and no internet
application.desc:
A small Android keyboard for English and Arabic. It has no internet permission, so nothing you type can leave the phone.
- Glide typing in both languages, offline - Word suggestions, next-word prediction and careful autocorrect that learn on the phone only - Hold space and drag to move the cursor; slide on delete to remove whole words - One-handed mode - Clipboard history with pins - Emoji panel with search by English or Arabic name - Classic tall keys, or Material You colours - Password fields: no learning, no history, hidden from screenshots
application.author: Altayeb

application.name: Shoebill
application.summary: Private mpv video player with an encrypted vault for videos and photos
application.desc:
Player - Plays what mpv plays: HEVC 10-bit, H.264, VP9, TrueHD/EAC3/DTS, ASS/PGS subtitles, network streams (http, HLS, rtsp). - Gestures for seeking, volume and brightness; double-tap to skip; speed; audio and subtitle tracks. - Screen lock, picture-in-picture, background audio, resume where you stopped, playlists.
Subtitles - Search OpenSubtitles, SubDL and Jimaku (with your own free API keys). - Style them: colour, size, outline, background box, bold, presets. - Drag a subtitle on screen to move it; pinch it to resize it. Manual timing sync. - Old Arabic `windows-1256` files are converted automatically.
Vault - Hide videos and photos inside the app. Moving a file in removes it from the gallery; moving it out puts it back in its original folder. - Its own PIN (4–16 digits), separate from the phone's lock screen. Fingerprint optional. - Decoy PIN opens a second vault; wipe PIN erases the real one. - 5 wrong PINs lock it (30 s, doubling up to 1 h). Changing the phone's clock does not end the wait. - Videos play straight from the encrypted file; nothing decrypted is written to disk. - Encrypted backup and restore (`.shoebillvault` file, password-protected). - Screenshots and screen recording blocked inside the vault.
Open source (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/altyb/shoebill
application.author: Altayeb
